name: LZR 308 200 MAX (Lazer, 200 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".590 (Oehler 89)". Marked (Oehler 89): Oehler 89 system. The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G7 BC, printed ".295 (Oehler 89)". Marked (Oehler 89): Oehler 89 system. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 4, Lazer - Ultra Long Range Hunting: Caliber .308, Grains 200, Minimum Required Twist *1-9", Part Number LZR 308 200 MAX, G1 BC .590 (Oehler 89), G7 BC .295 (Oehler 89), OAL 1.695", Bullet Projection 1.164"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1-2 inches faster is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: 1.164".
